title: Fear of being laughed at by class

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi has to answer, perform or show something in front of the class.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Kavi cannot control what classmates might think or say.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Imagining everyone's laughter feels worse than the actual task.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi knows the answer. Kavi even knows how to say it. But the thought of everyone laughing makes Kavi's hand stay firmly down.

title: Not chosen for a special school role

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi hoped to be chosen for a special class role but another child was selected.
storySeed.immediateWant: Be chosen or feel that the effort still mattered.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The decision has already been made.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi starts turning 'not chosen this time' into 'not good enough.'
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi had imagined standing at the front of the class. Then the teacher says someone else's name.

title: Being shortest or tallest in the class line

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi notices they are much shorter or taller than the other children while lining up.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: Their height is visible and cannot be changed.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi interprets standing out as being less important.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: Kavi joins the class line and looks around. Somehow everyone seems to fit neatly together—except Kavi.

title: Classmate won Student of the Month

storySeed.childExperience: Kavi has been working hard at school and hopes to be recognised, but another classmate receives the award.
storySeed.immediateWant: Feel proud of their own effort even though they were not chosen.
storySeed.immediateObstacle: The recognition has gone to someone else.
storySeed.emotionalTension: Kavi starts turning one missed award into a judgement about their ability.
storySeed.narrativeSummary: The teacher announces the winner. Applause fills the room, and Kavi claps too—but the smile feels harder to find than expected.
